entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I'm calling about an order. I need to return a jersey I bought. I'm just so disappointed it didn't work out.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into that for you. Could you please provide me with your order number?
Yes, it's VF88602. It's the ProFit Jersey. I saved up for it and I was so excited, but... it's just the wrong size.

Okay, I have your order pulled up. I see you received it 32 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue with the fit?

Oh, it's just the fit. I ordered my usual size, but this one is just way too tight across the shoulders. I feel terrible about it, I've been a loyal customer for so long. Is it possible to do an exchange for a larger size?
I understand completely. It's frustrating when the sizing isn't quite right on a piece you're excited about. Let me just check our policy for you. One moment.
Okay. I was just really hoping I could get the money back if an exchange isn't possible. Things are a bit tight right now.
Thank you for your patience. Yes, I can absolutely help with that. Since you received the jersey just over a month ago, you're still unfortunately outside our 10-day return window for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried it had been too long.

Not a problem at all. I've just initiated the return process for you. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file right now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll process your full refund.
That's wonderful. You've been a huge help. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
